title: I Gave Stockfish 1 Knibis Until I LOSE
summary: Reverse-odds series on lichess-style UI: Fairy-Stockfish (level 8) gets king + N Knibis (start 1, +1 after each narrator win). Knibis = moves like a knight but captures like a bishop. The variant used normally has a snake and two extra knibis on the narrator's minor-piece squares; he removed them, so the narrator has king, queen, rooks and pawns. He wins with 1-4 knibis using rook-supported passed pawns, draws vs 5 knibis (auto draw by insufficient material after the bot takes his last pawn), and loses vs 6 knibis.
rules: Knibis (fairy piece): non-capturing moves are knight jumps; captures slide like a bishop (diagonal, any distance).
Engine side: king + N knibis, N = 1 then +1 after each win.
Narrator side: K, Q, 2R and 8 pawns; minor-piece squares empty (fairy pieces removed). Promotion allowed (he promotes to a knibis once 'for funsies').
Normal chess rules otherwise; insufficient material auto-draw applies.
win_condition: Checkmate Fairy-Stockfish; add a knibis after each win; the run ends at the first loss (6 knibis in the video; 5 was a draw).
